authorization_basis: The product owner requested that the independent held-out evaluation plan and its authorization be frozen on 2026-08-09.

consumption.runtime_record_rule: The grant is consumed when the first corpus game is opened for play or the candidate is asked for its first corpus move. A failed read-only preflight or synthetic canary does not consume it.

decision_note: Authorize exactly one 64-pair, 128-game retained-v2 held-out evaluation after the frozen runner and final preflight gates pass. Safe exact resume may complete only the missing suffix of that same run.

permitted_before_consumption: implement and test the exact frozen evaluator
generate readiness evidence without opening a corpus game
permitted_execution: one complete evaluation under the exact frozen plan
safe exact resume of only the missing suffix after host interruption
prohibited: corpus, pair count, role order or result-dependent subset changes
baseline, node ceiling, rules, referee or adjudication changes
rerunning completed games or starting a second evaluation
new training, checkpoint promotion or model publication
resource expansion beyond the frozen ceiling

preconditions: the evaluator implements every requirement in the frozen plan
focused runner, route, replay, statistics and ledger tests pass
mandatory Malom and label-provenance tests pass
a read-only preflight reports ready without consuming a corpus game
dev is clean, published and equal to origin/dev
all candidate, database, corpus, MIF, rules and Sanmill pins verify
the candidate bundle verifies on deterministic CPU float32 inference
the evaluation output targets are absent or are a valid same-run partial ledger
no trainer or competing evaluator owns the bound resources
